title: From Cases to Criteria: Reusing Evaluation Knowledge for Task-Specific Rubric Generation
title_zh: 从案例到评估条目：复用评估知识以生成任务专属评分细则
abstract_en: Query-specific rubrics make LLM evaluation more fine-grained and transparent, and generating high-quality rubrics requires both identifying the target query's evaluation scope and specifying concrete checks. Historical rubrics provide reusable evaluation experiences, yet existing approaches reuse either complete query-rubric cases or aggregated criteria and dimensions without explicitly connecting recurring evaluation requirements to their criterion-level evidence and source-query context. This can preserve irrelevant task details or lose the broader evaluation structure. In this paper, we introduce RubricDuo, which organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared concepts, local concepts, criteria, and queries, where reusable evaluation requirements across queries are abstracted by shared concepts. Given a target query, RubricDuo first combines concepts relevant to the target query with retrieved historical cases to draft a rubric with broad coverage. It then revisits each draft criterion, retrieves concept-linked historical criteria and their source queries, and adapts applicable evidence to refine the criterion. Experiments on RubricBench and HealthBench demonstrate that RubricDuo achieves the overall best performance among the evaluated automatic methods in both alignment with human-authored rubrics and downstream LLM judging.
abstract_zh: 针对具体查询设计的评分细则能让大语言模型（LLM）评估更细粒度、更透明。高质量的细则既要明确评估范围，也要给出可核查的条目。现有方法往往直接复用完整的历史案例，或仅复用汇总后的评估条目和维度，未显式关联反复出现的评估要求、支撑这些要求的具体条目及其来源查询，因此可能引入无关细节或丢失整体评估结构。本文提出 RubricDuo，将历史查询及其评分细则组织为评分细则知识图谱（Rubric Knowledge Graph），连接评估维度、共享概念、局部概念、评估条目和查询，并用共享概念抽象可跨查询复用的评估要求。对于目标查询，RubricDuo 先结合相关概念与检索到的历史案例，起草覆盖面较广的评分细则；再逐条检索与相关概念相连的历史条目及其来源查询，借鉴适用内容来细化草案。在 RubricBench 和 HealthBench 上，RubricDuo 在与人工编写细则的一致性和下游 LLM 裁判表现两方面，均取得了所评测自动方法中的最佳整体表现。
key_points_zh: 现有方法复用完整案例时容易带入无关细节，只复用汇总后的条目或维度时又可能丢失整体评估结构。
RubricDuo 以共享概念抽象跨查询重复出现的评估要求，并通过知识图谱保留这些要求与具体条目及来源查询的联系。
生成分两阶段：先结合相关概念与历史案例确定评估范围，再利用概念关联的历史条目及其上下文逐条细化。
在 RubricBench 和 HealthBench 上，RubricDuo 在人工细则一致性和下游 LLM 裁判表现两方面均取得所评测自动方法中的最佳整体表现。
